name: customer-edit-01
title: Customer edit form
description: A controlled customer create/edit form with validation, submitting, failure/retry, permission and unsaved-change states. The application owns data, authorization and persistence.

idle.how: Controlled value/onChange with status="idle"; edit name, email, company and segment.

loading.how: status="loading" while the host loads the customer; fields and actions are unavailable.

empty.how: A form always has a value object; use empty fields with idle for customer creation.

no-results.how: Search results belong to the list block.

error.how: status="error" and optional error; onSubmit retries the preserved controlled values.

success.how: status="success" only after the application confirms a save; successMessage can replace the confirmation.

submitting.how: status="submitting"; disable inputs, save and cancel, announce progress and ignore duplicate submission.

validation-error.how: Submit missing/invalid name/email, or provide validationErrors for server field errors; link errors to controls and focus the first invalid field.

permission-denied.how: status="permission-denied" explains the denied operation and disables edits/submission.

unsaved.how: Cancel a dirty form to show Keep editing/Discard changes. initialValue or dirty defines the baseline. onCancelRequest delegates all cancellation requests to the host instead.

offline.how: The host detects connectivity and supplies error or another offline explanation; values stay controlled.

partial.how: This form edits one complete customer value; partial records must be completed by the host.

actions.name: change
consumer: Store the draft value and a baseline for dirty tracking; keep it through request failures.

actions.name: save
consumer: Set submitting synchronously, persist/authorize on the server, then provide success/error/permission-denied and updated field errors.

actions.name: cancel
consumer: Close/discard only after onCancel is called. If supplying onCancelRequest, own the dirty confirmation for every dismissal request, including Cancel; guard parent dialog dismissal and route navigation.

responsive.strategy: Single-column labeled form with wrapping messages and reachable save/cancel/discard actions.

consumer: Supply controlled value/onChange and an application-owned onSubmit; there is no backend or automatic persistence.
Enforce permissions and authoritative validation on the server; client validation is basic name/email guidance.
Set submitting before awaiting a request and keep the value on failures; do not show success before persistence confirms it.

The built-in unsaved guard protects Cancel unless onCancelRequest delegates it to the host. The host must guard all dismissal requests, Escape/outside clicks/navigation, retain focus and prevent dismissal during submission.
